output.answer: As of November 11, 2026, Amazon’s subsidiaries include well-known businesses such as Whole Foods Market, Twitch Interactive Inc. and Zoox. Its latest annual subsidiary disclosure, covering year-end 2025, lists Amazon.com Services LLC, Amazon.com Sales, Inc., Amazon Data Services, Inc., Amazon Web Services, Inc., Amazon Technologies, Inc., Amazon.com NV Investment Holdings LLC, Amazon US Services LLC, A100 ROW, Inc. and Day One Insurance, Inc.—each reported as 100%-owned at that reporting date. These are examples and officially disclosed significant subsidiaries, not an exhaustive list of every company in the Amazon group.
caveats: Amazon’s Exhibit 21 is expressly a list of significant subsidiaries, not a complete global subsidiary register.
The 100% ownership figures are from the year-end 2025 disclosure; they should not be interpreted as a newly verified ownership snapshot for November 11, 2026.
missing_fields: Complete global subsidiary roster current to November 11, 2026.

key_facts.fact: Amazon’s annual Exhibit 21 lists Amazon.com Services LLC; Amazon.com Sales, Inc.; Amazon Data Services, Inc.; Amazon Web Services, Inc.; Amazon Technologies, Inc.; Amazon.com NV Investment Holdings LLC; Amazon US Services LLC; A100 ROW, Inc.; and Day One Insurance, Inc. as significant subsidiaries, each 100%-owned.
Whole Foods Market became a wholly owned subsidiary of Amazon.com when its acquisition closed.
Twitch’s privacy notice explicitly identifies Twitch Interactive Inc. and its affiliates as subsidiaries of Amazon.com, Inc.
Amazon Science describes Zoox as an independent Amazon subsidiary.

basis.reasoning: Restates the user's question; no external evidence is needed to identify the requested subject.
